next.reason: 41, 42, 43, 46, 47, 49 keep their 1985 cases (46: an at-end READ is an unsuccessful READ, §2023:9.1.13.7 GR6 b) 'The preceding READ statement referencing that file connector was unsuccessful'; 41/42 add only DELETE FILE/UNLOCK). Two results differ. 1985 g. 'WRITE ... on a file not open in the I-O, output, or extend mode' gives no 48 for a sequential-access WRITE in I-O mode; §2023:9.1.13.7 GR8 a) 'If the access mode is sequential, the file connector is not open in the extend or output mode' gives 48. And 1985 d.2) 'rewrite a record to an indexed file and the record is not the same size' (44) is gone: 44 b) now covers only 'a sequential file' (§2023:9.1.13.7 GR4) and §2023:14.9.35.4 GR18 says for relative and indexed files the size 'may differ from the number of bytes in the record being replaced'.
